Description.Title: Reza2025_organoid_fusion
Description.Details: Experimental source, not a translated computational source. See source_model.json and README.md. Cell-resolved 2D CPM, initial geometry approximated from Fig.1b day-1 hollow organoids. Persistent 1 mg/L bilirubin and Dox-induced Gulo priming. No spatial forcing after initialization. Notch/ezrin gates heterotypic cohesion. TET1/HIF1A modules maintain lineage-biased identity. Local mixed cell contacts induce an intermediate functional state: an explicit inferred closure. GST, GS and glutamine are normalized diagnostic proxies, not absolute experimental units. MCS=2 minutes; t=0 is co-culture day 1 and t=8640 minutes is day 7. Initial 120 hepatocytes and 2 acellular lumen compartments, dx=2 micrometres. Mechanical, kinetic, growth and normalized proxy parameters are approximations, not paper values.
